review_description: To start with, this company looked great: reviews, cost, pre-install service! And then the installation happened. Since day one, it has been a problem. The inverter kept throwing errors and derating itself. Installer kept promising to come and fix it, but never did. Didn't show up when I managed to nail down a date with them. Dodging calls and emails. Then found out they had just disappeared: website, instagram, Facebook, all just gone! Turns out they have put too many panels on one mppt and it is causing the inverter to fault and mixed panels facing east and west on the same mppt too! I looked into these guys before choosing them and they seemed great, community minded, a company with a social purpose as well as a business purpose. Boy was I wrong! If they ever come back (which I doubt), I could NOT recommend them at all.

Has a good experience, the quote offered two system combinations, no hard sell, answered questions and knowledge about what they were selling and why was very helpful. Neat and tidy install and system is performing as stated. I would use Ever on Solar again and recommend them to friends and family. Good value system and well installed.

Good competitive quote, easy company to deal with. They went the extra mile to help us with an existing battery in place. Old solar system removed and New Solar System was installed quickly and efficiently on the day they said it would. System appears to be working great. I would be happy recommending this company to anyone else thinking of installing Solar.

From contacting the company for quote and installing the system, was completed within the week. We found the team to be friendly and professional. They were happy to answer any questions we had. They also organised the grid connection. I would recommend this company to anyone thinking of getting solar.
Smooth process, they did everything.Why does my review have to be longer than 10 words?
